feedback: The current 7-sensor symmetric array with 0.016 m sensor size and 0.16 m wheel track aims to improve lateral line coverage and reduce line loss events, based on iteration 3 evidence showing persistent line loss and moderate steering oscillation. If the next race shows reduced line loss events and lower rms_error, continue refining sensor positions and consider fine-tuning PID gains to further reduce steering oscillation. If steering oscillation remains high, consider slightly increasing wheel track or adjusting sensor weights to improve stability. If progress or completion rates remain low, consider reducing mass further or increasing base_speed to improve acceleration and finish rates. These suggestions are grounded in iteration 3 data where increased sensor count improved coverage but stability and completion on the slalom track remain challenges.
